info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Compliance Reporting Amendments API
info.description: The Compliance Reporting Amendments API enables users to submit amendments to existing compliance reports by referencing a specific submission ID. This API is designed for financial institutions and compliance teams responsible for maintaining accurate compliance records. By using this endpoint, users can ensure that any necessary adjustments to prior submissions are recorded efficiently. Typical consumers of this API include compliance officers and regulatory reporting specialists within banks or financial service providers.

post.summary: Create an amendment for the compliance submission.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create an amendment for a specific compliance submission identified by its unique resource ID. It ensures that any modifications made are tracked and recorded properly in the compliance reporting system.

requestBody.description: A request to amend the compliance report submission identified by RES-100045. This operation allows the user to update specific fields of the submission as needed.
